title: Committee of Supply – Heads C, D, F, G and Z
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Heads C, D, F, G and Z

sections.label: Main Estimates expenditure heads
sections.summary: The sums for Heads C, D, F, G and Z in the Main Estimates were put and agreed to en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: In respect of the Main Estimates, they are Heads C, D, F, G and Z.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I propose to take those Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Question, "That the sums stated for Heads C, D, F, G and Z which appear in the last column of the Schedule of estimated expenditure under the Main Estimates on page 6 of Paper Cmd 8 of 2017 stand part of the Main Estimates," put and agreed to.
